title: Chapter 254 Black Flame
content:
Chapter 254 Black Flame

An Xing pointed to Bai Lushuang in the square and said in a low voice: "In a quarter of an hour, I want to know all the information about that woman, including what she has done recently."

Hearing this order, Black Shadow nodded without any hesitation and said, "Yes, sir."

The next moment, the black shadow disappeared directly from the spot.

After doing all this, An Xing did not leave, but stood there, constantly rubbing his fingers, staring at the square.

At this time, Bai Lushuang, who was standing in the square and staring at the stage, did not realize that she had been targeted.

On stage.

Xun Heng stood up again at this time.

Jordanyang and Shi Liantian stood behind him respectively.

"Everyone, for the sake of fairness of the competition, all the materials and items in this alchemy competition are prepared by my Huangcheng."

As soon as these words were spoken, Jordan Yang's face changed slightly.

I have long been used to using my fairy-grade purple gold elixir furnace, but now I suddenly want to change it.

Don't say it earlier.

Jordan Yang was dissatisfied, but he didn't dare to say anything more.

Forget it, even the low-grade elixir can be refined by itself.

In his heart, his immortal-grade purple gold elixir furnace is definitely the best elixir furnace in the entire fairy world, no doubt about it.

As for Shi Liantian, from the beginning to the end, he looked expressionless, just looking in front of him faintly.

Finally, the competition began.

With a bell ringing.

Two red elixir furnaces that emitted a terrifying aura appeared in front of them with a bang.

Seeing the red elixir furnace that was obviously larger than the ordinary elixir furnace standing in front of him, Jordanyang's hands trembled slightly.

"This, is this?!"

On the side, Shi Liantian also looked lit up.

"Good furnace!"

Jordan Yang was shocked at this moment. He never expected that he would become a clown.

This elixir furnace is many times stronger than his immortal-grade purple gold elixir furnace.

Above the immortal!

The foundation of the deserted city is really unimaginable.

At this time, Xun Heng walked between the two with an apology smile and said with a wry voice: "Sorry, the city lord is not here, so he can only feel wronged and just make do with it first."

Listen, do you say it? !

Is this okay?

So what kind of life did I live before? !

Jordan Yang's eyelids twitched wildly, but since he came to Huangcheng, he has learned to control his temper.

If it were in the past, I might have started roaring.

Shi Liantian is obviously much calmer than Jordan Yang.

At this moment, he felt that the deserted city was not simple anymore.

Is this really a force that should exist in the fairy world?

What is the strength of the Lord of the Huangcheng City?

All kinds of doubts filled my heart, but it was obviously not the time to think.

It is urgent to win this boring competition first.

Immediately, Xun Heng began to announce the content of the competition.

There are three games in total.

The first trial was developed for the recovery pill.

The audience present had many alchemists, and the recovery pill was a pill that every alchemist would refine.

Then why do two top alchemists compare to the trial to make recovery pills?

Because the recovery pill is also of grade.

The higher the realm of a recovery pill, the lower the effect will be after taking it.

And Shi Liantian and the others compared who had the best recovery pill.

After reaching the Immortal Emperor Realm, the effect of the recovery pill is basically useless.

I can only use something I cherish more and live with myself and time to slowly recover from my injuries.

I heard the contents of the first competition.

Jordan Yang immediately smiled confidently.

Recovery Pill?

Hahaha, everyone knows that he once refined a top-level immortal recovery pill, which once caused a stir in the Immortal Realm, and countless strong people snatched it crazy.

In the end, Jordan Yang confiscated the recovery pill.

As a reward on the evil list.

Can be a role model among alchemists.

So he is 90% sure to win this competition when it comes to refining the recovery pill.

With another bell ringing.

The competition officially begins.

Suddenly, Jordanyang quickly selected the refining and recovery pill materials from the materials provided by Huangcheng.

The next moment, a purple flame rose from Jordanyang's hand, and the hot temperature suddenly came to his face.

The temperature in the entire square began to rise sharply at this moment.

"It appears, that's Ziyang True Fire! Master Qiao's Pill Fire!"

The Ziyang Pill Fire, combined with Jordanyang's immortal-grade purple gold alchemy furnace, made Jordanyang a famous alchemy master in the entire fairyland.

Of course, these are just external things after all. What really made Jordan Yang a unique technique.

Several tedious medicinal materials continued to fly into the alchemy furnace, and under the tempering of the purple yang elixir fire, they turned into pure energy.

"It seems that Master Qiao is in excellent condition and is stable."

Everyone's eyes were hot.

Off the stage, Bai Lushuang also smiled, "Teacher, he will definitely win."

The other disciples of the Alchemy Peak also nodded repeatedly.

Tan Songci didn't say anything, just watched all this silently.

But at this moment, his face changed and he looked at the other side of the stage in astonishment.

At the same time, the exclamation also sounded from the scene.

"That's it?!"

I saw that Shi Liantian also moved.

Buzz —

A ferocious black flame ignited from Shi Liantian's hand, and in a moment, the surrounding space began to melt continuously.

Seeing this scene, everyone was so shocked that they could no longer speak.

What kind of flame is this? It is even more terrifying than Master Qiao's Ziyang True Fire.

Next, Shi Liantian's operation was even more shocking.

Shi Liantian quickly found out the required materials and then stuffed them into the alchemy furnace.

"He's a stew?!"

An alchemist in the audience was surprised.

The others didn't speak, but their faces were very solemn and their brows were furrowed.

In a small space in the void.

Qin Feng looked at the two alchemy masters on the stage with excitement. Although he couldn't understand, he thought it was awesome.

"Sister Xue, your alchemist really has something to do."

Xiao Luo said in a deep voice: "He stuffed all the materials directly in this way, aren't he afraid of frying the pot?"

Obviously, Xiao Luo still knows a little about alchemy.

Listening to the two of them, Lu Xue was silent.

To be honest, this is the first time she has seen people refining elixirs, so how can she understand these?

"By the way."

Lu Xue suddenly thought of something, then waved her hand to the back and said with a smile: "Yuanyuan, come here quickly!"

Shi Liantian’s apprentice Yuanyuan is also here, but because she is not familiar with everyone, she just sat quietly in the corner and watched her master perform.

When Yuanyuan was stunned when she heard Lu Xue calling him, she immediately walked to Lu Xue's side.

"Round, sit."

Lu Xue gave Yuanyuan a seat.

Yuanyuan was not polite about this.

"Thank you, Sister Xue."

"It's okay."

At this time, Qin Feng and the others looked at Yuanyuan curiously, "Sister Xue, who is this?"

"My name is Yuanyuan, my master Shi Liantian."
